source.description:
PROBLEM: \`src/cli/config.ts\` \`showResolvedConfig()\` calls \`loadResolvedConfigReport()\` in \`src/specialist/resolution-diagnostics.ts:151\`, which reads \`config/specialists/<name>.specialist.json\` directly via \`readJsonFile\`. It bypasses \`SpecialistLoader\` and never applies the \`~/.config/specialists/user.json\` global overlay or \`.specialists/user/<name>\` repo overlay. Symptom: \`sp config show <spec> --resolved\` reports raw package canonical for fields like \`execution.extensions.serena\`, \`notes_mode\`, \`output_file\`, \`prompt.system_prompt_mode\`, \`execution.prompt_limit_bytes\`, \`execution.stdout_limit_bytes\` regardless of what the user actually overrode.

SUCCESS: \`sp config show <spec> --resolved\` reflects the same merged spec the runtime sees. Options: (a) replace direct \`readJsonFile\` with \`SpecialistLoader.get(name)\`, or (b) add \`--json\` mode that outputs the loader-merged spec while keeping the human text path readable. (a) is the clean fix.

SCRUTINY: medium (CLI output contract change; surface is operator-facing diagnostic)

SCOPE: \`src/specialist/resolution-diagnostics.ts\` (\`loadResolvedConfigReport\`, \`formatResolvedConfigReport\`), \`src/cli/config.ts\` (\`showResolvedConfig\`). Possibly add \`--json\` flag.

NON_GOALS: no changes to SpecialistLoader. No telemetry/observability changes.

CONSTRAINTS: keep existing human text format backward-compatible (don't break operators scripting on it).

VALIDATION: flip the \`describe.skip\` on \`tests/integration/cli/config-show-resolved.test.ts\` to \`describe\` and the 2 tests must pass. Run \`bun --bun vitest run tests/integration/cli/config-show-resolved.test.ts\`.

OUTPUT: source fix + green test + bd close referencing unitAI-gp7nq.8 and this bead.

DISCOVERED FROM: unitAI-gp7nq.8 test-engineer chain (job 7e3d09). Test file already authored with describe.skip; one-line flip unblocks it.
source.title: config show --resolved bypasses SpecialistLoader global overlay
